payload.session: uuid — the session whose scenes are reordered; its order is a row of its own, Session/<the session's order id> (aggregate_session::order_id), so two reorders of one session queue on it
payload.order: uuid[] — every scene of the session, each once, in the order they play: the first ranked 1, the last n, every rank rewritten in one write (scene-order-contiguous); an order that omits one, repeats one or names a scene of another session is refused, 422, and no rank changes
